title: Mike Hussey Joins Australia's Coaching Ranks for Ashes, World Cups and LA Olympics
excerpt: The former batter will consult for the 2027 Ashes and ODI World Cup and advise on T20 through the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and T20 World Cup — after turning down an approach from England.
body:
• Australia have appointed former batter Michael Hussey as a coaching consultant for the 2027 Ashes and the 2027 ODI World Cup in southern Africa.
  • He will also serve as a T20 advisor for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and the 2028 T20 World Cup in Australia and New Zealand, with a remit covering campaign strategy, opposition insights, player scouting and performance.
  • Hussey begins this month with Australia's home white-ball series against England and will assist the Test squad before the series against New Zealand.
  • He was approached by England under new Test coach Stephen Fleming — his long-time Chennai Super Kings colleague — and chose Australia instead.

Australia have appointed former batter Michael Hussey as a coaching consultant for the 2027 Ashes and ODI World Cup, and as a T20 advisor for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and T20 World Cup in Australia and New Zealand, ESPNcricinfo reported. The ICC confirmed Hussey will join head coach Andrew McDonald's group ahead of those tournaments.

A wider brief than his earlier stints

Hussey has done short secondments with Australia under McDonald in recent years, mainly as an extra batting consultant in the lead-up to the Perth Test, but was unavailable for deeper commitments because of commentary roles and coaching positions with Chennai Super Kings in the IPL and Welsh Fire in the Hundred. His eight-year stint as CSK's batting coach has now ended, Cricbuzz reported, as the franchise resets its staff — freeing him for the expanded Australia role.

The T20 side of the job is the major focus. Hussey was part of England's winning T20 World Cup coaching group under Matthew Mott in 2022, and Cricket Australia's remit for him spans campaign strategy, opposition insights, player scouting and performance through the 2028 cycle — which includes cricket's return at the Los Angeles Olympics and a home T20 World Cup.

"The ICC confirmed Hussey will join head coach Andrew McDonald's group ahead of those tournaments."

The England approach he declined

Hussey was approached for a role by long-time colleague Stephen Fleming when the New Zealander took over the England Test job earlier this year. He chose Australia. His consultancy begins immediately: a young Australia squad's white-ball series against England at home this month — Cricbuzz dates the T20I series start to later in November — followed by assistance to the Test squad ahead of the summer series against New Zealand.

The appointment gives Australia a single consultant threaded through four major assignments — the 2027 Ashes in England, the 2027 ODI World Cup in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia, and the two 2028 T20 landmarks — under a head coach, McDonald, with whom Hussey has worked in short bursts for years. The difference now is that the bursts have become a brief.
